description: Scored US and global macro briefs from official public data (FRED, BLS, BEA, EIA, Census, TreasuryDirect, ECB, FDIC, CFPB, World Bank, IMF), plus Pocket Network health and crypto liquidity (DefiLlama). Each brief is a 0-100 score with label, trend versus the horizon, the inputs that drive it, risk flags, confidence and a citation for every input. Includes a CPI inflation calculator. POST /v1/brief {vertical} returns one scored brief; POST /v1/overview returns every brief at once; POST /v1/verticals lists them. Verticals: macro-regime, inflation, labor, rates, credit-stress, commodities, global-compare, housing, consumer, country-risk, health-systems, education, yield-curve, bank-health, global-rates-fx, treasury-demand, energy-supply, trade-flows, business-formation, pokt-network-health, crypto-liquidity, supply-chain-pressure, food-inflation, state-labor, imf-outlook. Raw scored series: /v1/signals, /v1/signal, /v1/explain, /v1/catalog. Every response is a single JSON object. Research signal, not investment advice.

rpc_types.notes: POST /v1/verticals, POST /v1/brief, POST /v1/overview, POST /v1/signals, POST /v1/signal, POST /v1/explain, POST /v1/catalog, POST /v1/inflation/adjust; GET /v1/version, /v1/health. JSON body only. Bad input returns 400 + JSON.

serving.backend: Node.js HTTP server (zero npm dependencies) behind a RelayMiner at http://<container>:8080. No caller auth. Answers come from a private hub refreshed by a scheduled collector of official public data; 5-minute cache.
serving.notes: Gateway operators: configure as type passthrough with rpc_types ["rest"].
